newsitem.title: USA: Palomar names Louis Valente CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Palomar names Louis Valente CEO, president.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Thursday its board named Louis Valente as the company's chief executive officer and president effective immediately.
He replaces co-founder Michael H. Smotric as president, who was named vice chairman of the board and the company's chief technical officer. Valente is also a director of the company.
Former chief executive Steven Georgiev, who also co-founded the company, will retain his position as chairman, the company said.

Valente was formerly senior vice president at EG&G Inc,, where he negotiated acquisitions and mergers, Palomar said. He held a variety of positions at EG&G since 1968, including vice president of corporate development and corporate treasurer, it added.
Palomar also said its board has authorized the repurchase of up to 1.0 million of the company's common shares over a one-year period on the open market.
The timing and amounts of purchases will be governed by applicable Securities and Exchange Commission rules and market conditions, it said.
Valente said the company may use a portion of its excess cash reserves to fund the repurchase.
